newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN KORAMIC BUYS PART OF SWISS PACIFIC.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN KORAMIC BUYS PART OF SWISS PACIFIC.

text.p: Belgian Koramic Building Products said on Tuesday its fully-owned Koramic Finishing Products division acquired the industrial adhesives activities of Swiss Pacific SA.
It gave no financial details of the deal.

Koramic said in a statement that the adhesives activities of Swiss Pacific, which also produces and distributes detergents and disinfectants, were carried out in a production unit at Gland, near Lausanne.
The activities had now been accomodated in newly-formed firm Cermix SA, a 100-percent subsidiary of Koramic Finishing Products based in Gland.
Koramic said the acquired activity was a perfect basis for further growth in the adhesives sector in Switzerland and neighbouring countries.
